findings.body: The entire change records a task start with status `working`; it does not deliver the required client trial. The task contract in `plans/FORGE-NEXT-1.md:495–501` requires initializing the private client from `v1.0.0-rc.1`, merging a fix with green checks and a clean review, and applying and reporting branch protection. Complete that trial and provide its merged pull request and verification evidence before treating this part as delivered.
findings.title: Not done: A brand-new client set up with the new Forge makes a small fix, and it is merged the same way.

findings.body: This task explicitly requires adding or changing the trial client's CI, but the supplied patch contains only a start record. No client workflow or test exercising the small fix is delivered. Add the client CI and a meaningful regression test for the fix, and establish that the required checks pass on its pull request.
